thm:direct-sum-firewall.title: Direct-sum firewall
thm:direct-sum-firewall.note: Proved: any PSD blocks assemble to a PSD direct sum (including a singular or zero second block), the compression to the first summand equals T1 exactly, and it is independent of the second block - so a coercive statement about one typed block constrains nothing about the other without an intertwining theorem.

prop:old-abel.title: Abel reduction
prop:old-abel.note: Proved: for Re s > 0 and absolutely summable weighted coefficients (Summable ||c(n)|| n^{-Re s}), int_1^infty (sum_{n<=x} c(n)) x^{-s-1} dx = (1/s) sum_n c(n) n^{-s}, by dominated tsum/integral interchange with per-n tail evaluation int_n^infty x^{-s-1} dx = n^{-s}/s. The manuscript states only s != 0 on the vertical line; the formal statement carries Re s > 0 as hypothesis, which is the regime where the tail integrals converge absolutely and is the regime the corollary uses. The displayed shifted-product instance c(n) = a_i(n) a_j(n+h) is NCG.abel_reduction_shifted (nonnegative shift h; negative shifts relabel the two ports).

cor:old-zero.title: The zero-shift slice is not an $L$-function frame
cor:old-zero.note: Proved: the zero-shift slice with a_i = Lambda rho_i has Dirichlet coefficient Lambda(n)^2 rho_i(n) rho_j(n) -- a squared, unconjugated von Mangoldt weight, formalized as the identity int_1^infty A(x) x^{-s-1} dx = (1/s) sum_n Lambda(n)^2 rho_i(n) rho_j(n) n^{-s} for Re s > 0. The manuscript sentences observing that this weight is neither an L-function coefficient sequence nor of the form -L'/L (no Euler product / no single-prime support) are interpretive prose about the displayed formula and are not separately formalized.

cor:twin-gold-port.title: Twin and Goldbach ports

thm:v002-weyl-barrier.title: Scalar-invariant two-channel Weyl barrier

Scalar-shift invariance of Gamma^W is definitional in these coordinates (shifts cancel from the eigenvalue-Rayleigh differences).

thm:v002-scalar-bulk.title: Scalar bulk carries no ordering
thm:v002-scalar-bulk.note: Proved: if the compressed defect L - cI - D has Rayleigh quotients bounded by epsilon on the physical subspace W (rank >= 2, witnessed by a two-dimensional trial subspace V <= W, with the unit vector g in W), then Gamma^W(L,D;g) <= 2 epsilon. The operator-norm hypothesis ||P(L-cI-D)P|| <= epsilon enters the manuscript proof only through the Rayleigh quotients of vectors of Ran P, which is how the formal hypothesis is stated. Spectral quantities in Courant-Fischer min-max form as in thm:v002-weyl-barrier. The concluding in-particular sentence (epsilon = o(a) on a growing subspace) is interpretive prose.

lem:prime-power.title: Prime-power contamination
lem:prime-power.note: Proved in master form: for any injective target map into [1,Y] the von Mangoldt correlation mass carried by proper-prime-power coordinates is at most 4 sqrt(Y) (log Y)^3, from the base-exponent count #PP(Y) <= sqrt(Y) log_2 Y and Lambda <= log. The polylog exponent is coarser than the displayed O(sqrt(X) log X) (which needs Chebyshev theta <= Cx); the crude form suffices for every downstream use, and covers both the shifted (n, n+h) and fixed-sum (n, N-n) windows through the injective-map parameter.

thm:car-prime.title: Exact ordered-history prime filter
thm:car-prime.note: NCG/Arithmetic/ArithParity.lean: the signed permutation sum vanishes for k >= 2 (pairing by a fixed transposition), so the CAR endpoint on the symmetric ordered-history source returns the target at depth one and annihilates every deeper symmetric history (car_prime_endpoint, linear-map form). The anticommutation action E_n|pi> = sgn(pi)|n> is the declared CAR input. Standard axioms only.

thm:parity-recovery.title: Exact depth-one recovery
thm:parity-recovery.note: NCG/Arithmetic/ArithParity.lean: P1 = (M-J)/2, P2 = (M+J)/2 from M = P1+P2, J = -P1+P2, and the quantitative clause J <= (1-2d)M => P1 >= dM. Standard axioms only.

thm:twin-chain.title: Conditional twin-prime chain
thm:twin-chain.note: NCG/Arithmetic/ArithParity.lean: finite-carrier form with the o(M) hypothesis quantified as J <= (1-2d)M (the manuscript's own general clause): a positive twin carrier with mass >= m0 > 0 and small Moebius current supports a twin-prime pair (carrier_prime_mass extracts a positively weighted prime target). The (T1)-(T3) hypotheses are the declared open certificates. Standard axioms only.

thm:gold-chain.title: Conditional binary Goldbach chain
thm:gold-chain.note: NCG/Arithmetic/ArithParity.lean: same skeleton for the Goldbach carrier: positive mass plus small Moebius current produces primes a, b with a + b = N. The (G1)-(G3) hypotheses are the declared open certificates. Standard axioms only.

thm:HL-sufficient.title: Classical asymptotic sufficient conditions
thm:HL-sufficient.note: Proved: a Hardy-Littlewood twin asymptotic with positive singular series and O(X^{1/2+delta}) error (delta < 1/2), taken as hypothesis, forces infinitely many twin primes (finitely many twins leave only a bounded prime-pair mass plus the proper-prime-power contamination, which is o(X) by lem:prime-power and log-power asymptotics); the uniform Goldbach lower asymptotic likewise forces a prime decomposition of every sufficiently large even N. The external asymptotics are the stated inputs, exactly as in the manuscript.

thm:v003-signed-separator.title: Exact cancellation of the squarefree $P_2$ layer

At depth >= 3 the Lean statement gives J <= 0 from B_3 >= 0 (coefficient nonnegativity); the strict negativity display -12/(7 alpha) B_3 < 0 at depth exactly three is not separately certified. thm:v003-cauchy-minorant.title: Stable Cauchy minorant
thm:v003-cauchy-minorant.note: Proved with the entire packet E_{z,X} realized as its absolutely convergent Taylor series sum_j B_j z^j (factorial decay of the Mellin coefficients from |Lambda_j(n)| <= tau(n) (log n)^j; the product display is the formal identity NCG.mellin_degree, as in the thm:v003-mellin-degree record): bank_alias is the exact root-of-unity aliasing D^(j) = sum_{d = j mod m} B_d r^d/r^j (geometric root sums + Complex.exp_eq_one_iff), cauchy_minorant is the stable sandwich 0 <= P_{<=2} - c <= theta C_s E_s by coefficientwise domination 0 <= 1_{d in {1,2}} - kappa_d <= theta C_s s^d against the nonnegative coefficients (the residue-class tail estimate r^{d-j} = theta^l s^{d-j} <= theta C_s s^d), and bank_weight gives the m-independent coefficient weight r^{-j} per bank, hence the display total r^{-1} + r^{-2} + theta C_s.

corollary:dyadic-bank.title: Dyadic bank

thm:v003-twinfree-marginals.title: Twin-free realization of all sub-half marginals
thm:v003-twinfree-marginals.note: Proved: for any admissible tuple h : Fin k -> Z and marginals 0 <= pi_i <= 1/2 there is an explicit probability distribution on subsets of coordinates (nonnegative, total mass one) supported on independent sets of the twin graph G_2(H) (edges |h_i - h_j| = 2) with vertex marginals exactly pi_i. NCG.maynard_ceiling substitutes J <= I into the standard first-moment asymptotic pi_i = (log R/log N) J/I + o(1), R = N^{theta/2-delta} (taken as hypothesis: it is the external Maynard input), and yields convergence of the marginals to a limit <= theta/2 - delta < 1/2 -- inside the twin-free regime of NCG.twinfree_marginals, which is the compatibility assertion.
